01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Custom software is useful when a critical workflow does not fit off-the-shelf tools. We can scope dashboards, portals, CRM features and operational systems based on the people who use them.

We begin with the smallest reliable release, define roles and data needs, then plan integrations, security and ongoing ownership.
